preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or have control over the marketing address (0x17d782117bf626150c109c25e8bCfe9FBb212090)
Contract must have a non-zero BNB balance (accumulated from fees or buybacks)

exploit_hint: The contract uses .transfer() in transferToAddressETH() which has a fixed 2300 gas stipend. If the marketing address is a contract with complex fallback/receive logic, it may fail, locking BNB in the contract. As owner, call Sweep() to drain all BNB to owner address, or if you control marketing address, make it a contract that consumes >2300 gas when receiving BNB to block transfers and accumulate BNB for later owner sweep.
